notes.title: Upcoming Update: Skip Tutorial Feature, Bug Fixes, and DLC
notes.notes:
Greetings all!

We are on the cusp of releasing both a new DLC package for DoS as well as some much needed updates and bug fixes to the vanilla game.

The biggest change to the base game is the addition of the highly requested "Skip Tutorial" feature. This should make achievement hunting sessions much more tolerable. Those with a keen eye will notice updates to sound effects, art, and room layouts as well.

The original intent was to release several themed DLC packages for the game, but we ultimately decided to combine them all into one large package. This package will feature new achievements, 8 new SCPs and a Mobile Task Force designed to contain SCP-029. Numbered among the list are fan favorites SCP-682 and SCP-079. New item SCPs have also been added to help SCP-029 combat these new threats.

All of these additions and updates are undergoing final testing. We hope to make all of this available to you in the very near future.

Cheers,
 - Blackrose

notes.title: SCP-173 Art Update
notes.notes: We decided to go ahead and change out all of SCP-173's art to comply with licensing restrictions. Game functionality has not changed.
